blocks.text: Hezekiah's illness and recovery are followed by pride, then by humility. This episode reflects a recurring pattern in Chronicles: seeking the LORD, praying, receiving prophetic instruction, or humbling oneself are set alongside the danger of turning away. The pattern helps readers see verses 24–26 as more than a private incident in Hezekiah's life; they also continue a recurring way the book portrays Judah's kings and people.
